forms.name: Pre-Rush
forms.text: Threats fast enough to act before every PC.

forms.name: Rush
forms.text: Act first among the PCs, at -2 AP.

forms.name: Rush (NPC)
forms.text: Threats acting after the PCs who Rush.

forms.name: Steady
forms.text: Act in the middle, with no AP change.

forms.name: Steady (NPC)
forms.text: Threats acting after the Steady PCs.

forms.name: Poise
forms.text: Act late among the PCs, at +2 AP.

trackers.name: AP
trackers.text: Action Points: 8 at most unless modified; armor, shields and wounds lower the maximum. Moving one sector costs 1 AP.

trackers.name: Stress
trackers.text: Threshold: END + WIL + Threat Level. Reaching it calls for an Overload check.

trackers.name: Armor Grade
trackers.text: Absorbs Systemic Wounds until spent; a spent armor loses its tags.

trackers.name: PsW
trackers.text: Psychic Wounds: 4 slots for PCs (Shaken 1, Shaken 2, Delirious, Mental Collapse).

trackers.name: CvW
trackers.text: Cardiovascular Wounds: 4 slots for PCs (Bleeding 2, Bleeding 4, Bleeding 10, Cardiac Rupture).

trackers.name: ReW
trackers.text: Respiratory Wounds: 4 slots for PCs (Shallow Breathing twice, Lungs Collapsed, Suffocating).

trackers.name: NvW
trackers.text: Nervous Wounds: 4 slots for PCs (Disrupted, System Shock, Paralyzed, Nerves Collapse).

trackers.name: MsW Left Arm
trackers.text: Musculoskeletal Wounds: Crippled 1, Crippled 2, Broken, Torn Out.

trackers.name: MsW Right Arm
trackers.text: Musculoskeletal Wounds: Crippled 1, Crippled 2, Broken, Torn Out.

trackers.name: MsW Left Leg
trackers.text: Musculoskeletal Wounds: Crippled 1, Crippled 2, Broken, Torn Out.

trackers.name: MsW Right Leg
trackers.text: Musculoskeletal Wounds: Crippled 1, Crippled 2, Broken, Torn Out.

tags.name: Advanced Firing Position
tags.text: A commanding, prepared position above the enemy. Ranged Attack rolls have Advantage (ALL).

tags.name: Artificial Gravity
tags.text: A Move Action that starts here covers 1 more sector (20 ft).

tags.name: Bottleneck
tags.text: Room for one character, or two fighting in melee.

tags.name: Darkness
tags.text: Characters here see at most X sectors.

tags.name: Difficult Terrain
tags.text: Moving in, out of or through needs a Traversal check (DR 15 or more). A failure uses up 1 sector of movement.

tags.name: Environmental Object
tags.text: A mission-critical spot (terminal, cache, reactor) to interact with as the GM allows.

tags.name: Firing Position
tags.text: An elevated position over the enemy. Ranged Attack rolls have Advantage (1).

tags.name: Heavy Cover
tags.text: Sturdy protection: only Devastating Hits deal damage. Suppressing attacks deal none but still Suppress.

tags.name: Kill Zone
tags.text: Out of any cover and exposed.

tags.name: Light Cover
tags.text: Some protection: Grazing Hits miss and Precise Hits count as Grazing. Suppressing attacks deal none but still Suppress.

tags.name: Line of Sight Breaker
tags.text: Too large to see over or around: no sight or Ranged Attack across it.

tags.name: Mined Sector
tags.text: A hidden mine or trap that goes off on entry. Found with a Scan and an Awareness check (Basic DR 20, Advanced DR 10); disarmed from next door with Engineering (DR 20), or crossed knowingly with Traversal (DR 20). Hide the region from players.

tags.name: Narrow Opening
tags.text: Connects two sectors through a gap. A character starting or ending a Move here may Block: nobody passes, and sight between the sectors only reaches the blocker.

tags.name: Obscured
tags.text: Smoke, fog or dust: attacks at or through it have Disadvantage (ALL); Stealth checks have Advantage (ALL).

tags.name: Zero-g
tags.text: Moving in, out of or through needs a Traversal check (DR 15); a failure ends the Move. Attacks have Disadvantage (ALL). A Ballistic or Propelled ranged attack pushes the shooter 1 sector away from the target.

tags.name: Advantage
tags.text: Advantage (X) on rolls.

tags.name: Disadvantage
tags.text: Disadvantage (X) on rolls.

tags.name: Blinded
tags.text: Disadvantage (2).

tags.name: Concussed
tags.text: Disadvantage (1).

tags.name: Disoriented
tags.text: Can only target entities within Adjacent range.

tags.name: Electrocuted
tags.text: No Armor Resistance until the end of their next turn.

tags.name: Exposed
tags.text: Can't benefit from cover.

tags.name: Frozen
tags.text: Can't Move or take Reactions. Attacks with Disadvantage (1); attacks against them have Advantage (1).

tags.name: Immobile
tags.text: Can't take the Move Action.

tags.name: Poisoned
tags.text: Vulnerable to Cardiovascular Wounds until a Medical item removes it.

tags.name: Restrained
tags.text: Loses 2 max AP at the start of each turn (a threat: one Attack and one Reaction slot) and can't Move. The opposed check is rolled again each turn.

tags.name: Slowed
tags.text: -1 AP (a threat: one fewer Movement slot).

tags.name: Stunned
tags.text: Can't Move or take any Action.

tags.name: Suppressed
tags.text: Line of sight limited to their own sector until their next turn starts.

tags.name: Winded
tags.text: Moves cost +1 AP (a threat needs two Movement slots per sector).

tags.name: Concealed
tags.text: Can't be targeted except by Area of Effect. Lost on a failed Stealth check or any attack.

tags.name: Invisible
tags.text: Can't be seen or targeted except by Area of Effect; Stealth checks have Advantage (ALL). Lost on a failed Stealth check or any attack.

tags.name: Bleeding
tags.text: Takes X Stress at the start of each turn. Bleeding attacks also make the target Vulnerable to Cardiovascular Wounds.

tags.name: Cardiac Rupture
tags.text: Incapacitated and bleeding out: dies in 2 rounds unless stabilized.

tags.name: Shaken
tags.text: Disadvantage (X).

tags.name: Delirious
tags.text: Disadvantage (ALL).

tags.name: Mental Collapse
tags.text: Incapacitated, not dead.

tags.name: Crippled
tags.text: Arm: Disadvantage (X). Leg: Moves cost 1 more AP.

tags.name: Broken
tags.text: Arm: Disadvantage (ALL). Leg: can't take the Move Action.

tags.name: Torn Out
tags.text: The limb is lost; Incapacitated, and dies in 3 rounds unless stabilized.

tags.name: Shallow Breathing
tags.text: Maximum AP -2 for each.

tags.name: Lungs Collapsed
tags.text: Maximum AP -4.

tags.name: Suffocating
tags.text: Air cut off: Incapacitated in 2 rounds, dead in 3, unless a Respiratory wound is healed. Life Support armor prevents it.

tags.name: Disrupted
tags.text: Disadvantage (ALL).

tags.name: System Shock
tags.text: All cybernetics stop working until this wound is treated.

tags.name: Paralyzed
tags.text: Incapacitated until medical aid heals the wound.

tags.name: Nerves Collapse
tags.text: Incapacitated and seizing: dies in 3 rounds unless stabilized.

tags.name: Incapacitated
tags.text: Out of the fight until helped.

tags.name: Channeling
tags.text: Mid-ritual. Taking damage calls for a Mental Prowess check (Magus DR 15, Theurgist DR 20) or the spell Miscasts.

tags.name: Deranged
tags.text: Cortex Knight: AP set to 5, spent attacking the closest entity.

tags.name: Ambusher
tags.text: Noctis Commando: Grazing Hits become Precise Hits.

tags.name: Marked For Death
tags.text: The Sniper's Precise Hits on this target become Devastating and ignore Light Cover.

tags.name: Ghost
tags.text: Saboteur: stands on a sector corner; the four sectors around are Point Blank. Lost on damage or losing Concealed.

tags.name: Soaring Combatant
tags.text: Interdictor: may take another action at any sector passed during a Move.

tags.name: Access
tags.text: Harrower: protocol effects can be used on this entity.

tags.name: Flow Rupture
tags.text: Harrower protocols can target this entity.

tags.name: Rigged to Blow
tags.text: Saboteur: this vehicle detonates after its next Move Action.

tags.name: Unpleasant Surprise
tags.text: Saboteur: a hidden charge. On detonation, 2 MsW ignoring armor and 3 Stress; 2 Stress to others in the sector.

tags.name: Vicissitual Infection
tags.text: Infected by a Vector's microorganism.

tags.name: Glowing
tags.text: Homunculus: entities within Medium range have Disadvantage (1) on Stealth.

tags.name: Synthetic
tags.text: Made synthetically: open to Cyberwarfare, passes Mental Prowess checks.
